name: Asahina Shougo
source:
Asahina Shougo is a male member of the Four Holy Swords. He wears glasses and has a distinctive scar down the right side of his face. He is the leader of the first squadron of the Black Knights and tends to tease [url=/c84176]Chiba[/url] about her crush on  [url=/c83985]Toudou[/url]. Like Chiba, he develops a distrust for [url=/c82213]Zero[/url] following the Black Rebellion, questioning his tendency to keep secrets and bring on new members[spoiler] such as Rolo and [url/=c84174]Jeremiah[/url] with no discussion. During the second battle of Tokyo, he is killed in the blast from Nina's F.L.E.I.J.A. bomb, but not before transmitting information about Zero's massacre of the Geass Order to prove Zero can not be trusted[/spoiler]. 

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Code_Geass_characters#The_Black_Knights]Wikipedia[/url].]
